description: Receive one complete evidence-backed Visibility Check per eligible user for a business, its website and market. Requires the business's own website (not a social profile or link-in-bio page); ask the user for it before calling; without one, offer the direct creator, video or search actions instead. Uses normal login, including consumer email. This is optional: a specific creator, video or export request should use its own action directly. Returns a durable operation; read candidate themes with socialseal_get_visibility_check, select them with socialseal_continue_visibility_check, then retrieve the complete report with socialseal_get_visibility_check: submission or partial evidence is not completion. Failed or partial-only reports restore eligibility; reconnects for the same brand, market, platform and website reuse released work. If the free check is already allocated to a different brand, market, platform or website, status is complimentary_in_use: nothing new was started, and the result names the brand, market and website that hold the check (operationId, locator, market, targetWebsiteUrl); that report is not the requested one.

market.description: Country code for the audience being researched.

targetWebsiteUrl.description: The business's own public website, for example acme.com. Required; social profiles and link-in-bio pages are rejected.

workspaceId.description: Resolve the user's authorized workspace; reuse the only workspace without asking for its ID.

name: socialseal_start_visibility_check

fieldPaths.description: Deduplicated JSON pointer patterns (* matches array elements) into source payloads before text truncation and existing structuredContent.result or structuredContent. Original structured values are unchanged.

title: Start a complimentary Visibility Check
